biggestGap: The frame has no depth: the newly added DOF produces zero measurable defocus on any fruit at any depth, and light does not attenuate with distance either, so every object sits pasted on one flat plane in a black void.
evidence: R1's flood is genuinely fixed (idle corners 177/147 -> 0.0/0.0/28.9/0.3, blown 1.91% -> 0.273% vs plate-01's 0.115%; bloom mass px>180 in 12-idle-blade 54320 -> 6589; highlight R/B now 1.42 vs plate's 1.34) so this is a real +26. But DOF does nothing measurable. In shots/r2/09-combo+50ms.png the five fruit span 78-118 px apparent diameter (a real depth spread) and their silhouette 10-90 edge widths are 1.16, 0.85, 1.10, 1.84, 0.19 px -- all sub-2px and UNCORRELATED with apparent size. High-frequency energy (laplacian variance) near-vs-far is 261 vs 168 in 09-combo and 300 vs 179 in 13-load, ratios of 1.5-1.7x that are explained by texture content alone; plate-02's actual shallow focus shows a 46x ratio (bg lapvar 0.12 vs subject 5.58). Depth attenuation is also absent and in fact inverted: in 09-combo the nearest melon (118 px wide) has body mean luminance 89.5 while the far apple (78 px) reads 133.1. Source confirms it: src/render/stage.js:162 sets focalLength (three's 'how far from the focal plane before completely out of focus', in world units) to 5.0 while focus tracks the whole camera distance (line 384, U.focus = camera.position.length() ~= 13.5), so the entire playfield sits inside the in-focus slab and the CoC never exceeds a texel at the 640x360 render size. This trips the bar's explicit auto-fail 'Everything in focus at every depth (R1b is emphatically shallow-DOF)'. Secondary, not the headline: the subject is now under-lit -- our watermelon body in 01-whole-watermelon has p90 luminance 131.6 and 13.3% of body above 120, against plate-01's watermelon at 177.7 and 28.8%, with 6 highlight blobs above 200 (largest 111 px) versus the plate's 1334; 96.4% of our idle frame is exactly RGB(0,0,0) against the plate's 7.4%; and the key reads upper-LEFT (highlight centroid dx -0.29, dy -0.44 of radius) where plate-01's is hard upper-right. Blind: instant. 12-idle-blade is a field of uniform round bokeh discs on black and 09-combo is five equally crisp, equally lit stickers on a black band -- no viewer would hesitate.
fix: In src/render/stage.js, make the focal slab narrower than the playfield instead of wider than it. Drop U.focalLength from 5.0 to ~1.2 world units (line 162), and stop pinning U.focus to camera.position.length() (line 384) -- instead drive it each frame from the view-space Z of the fruit nearest the cut plane (or the stage-box front face) so the back rank sits 2-3 focal lengths out. Then verify by re-measuring: the far fruit's silhouette 10-90 edge width must exceed 4 px at 640x360 while the near fruit stays under 1.5 px. Also raise U.bokeh floor above 1.3 only after the CoC is nonzero; increasing bokeh scale while CoC is ~0 changes nothing.
